name: Houston {GAME}n
description:
At a time when our spaceships are travelling through the universe, a new star has lit up in the racing tank building — Houston {GAME}n. The members of this team are progressive thinkers of their time, who know a lot about technologies of the future. High-speed cars that withstand the effects of extra high and cryogenic temperatures can bring a triumphant victory to their owners.
Thanks to innovative ideas and an extraordinary approach, the creators of this racing team have formed the following motto: "Houston, we have no problems."
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on february 24th, 2023.
Houston {GAME}n could have been obtained during The «Rally Tankcar» Event.
